description: Check the status of an async post generation batch. Returns 'generating', 'caption_ready', 'completed', 'failed', or 'partial'. 'caption_ready' means the captions are final and the images are still rendering — show the user the caption text then, do not wait for the pictures. Each post also carries imageStatus: pending | ready | none.

groupId.description: The group ID returned from generate_posts

name: get_generation_status
title: Get Generation Status
